alyssa: Final sync — staging cutover + SI runbook finalization. Quick agenda: press embargo checklist, landing toggle, partner badges, SI handoff, rollback plan. 10pm PT slot confirmed?

devin: 10pm PT works for partners. SI leads can join 9:30 for dry run.

maria: PR embargo lift is at 11:00 PT. We need landing live by 10:50 so press has stable page.

jonathan: Engineering: can serve landing toggle + feature flag rollback. Will run canary route 10:10-10:30, full switch at 10:45 if green.

samir: SI teams: we'll run connector smoke tests during dry run. Need the service account creds by 9:15. @devin can you confirm delivery?

devin: Confirmed — sending creds to SI slack channel and Secure Share at 9:00.

ellie: Design + assets: partner badges uploaded to S3 (s3://redwood-assets/partners/2026-03). Landing copy includes co-branding. QA checklist attached.

ops-bot: deploybot: scheduled deploy to staging starts 21:40 PT, proceed with canary at 22:10 PT.

alyssa: Copy of minimal launch checklist (please mark done inline during run):
```
- 09:00: deliver SI creds (devin)
- 09:30: SI dry run (samir + SI leads)
- 10:10: canary traffic (jonathan)
- 10:30: smoke pass + metrics green (eng/sre)
- 10:45: feature flag -> 100%
- 10:50: landing page toggle live (maria)
- 11:00: embargo lift (maria)
- rollback window until 12:00 if issues (eng + partners)
```

jonathan: For metrics green we need 3 consecutive 2-min windows with error rate <0.5% and p95 latency <220ms. If violation, immediate rollback to previous model variant and disable batching.

samir: SI acceptance tests: auth, provisioning flow, tenant onboarding, sample inference run. Tests are in repo: https://git.internal/redwood/si-tests/tree/main.

maria: Marketing: final social snippets ready, press PDF in Google Drive. Will send embargo list at 09:45.

alyssa: Owners: devin (partner creds + partner comms), jonathan (canary + rollback), samir (SI dry run), maria (landing + press). Add any missing owners now.

devin: I'll own partner on-call for first 2 hours post-launch. +1 for handoff plan.

ellie: I'll be on standby for quick hero/tiny copy fixes during cutover.

jonathan: small ops note: feature-flag rollout uses blue/green toggle. Rollback script: `./scripts/flag-rollback.sh marketplace-hero` — tested on staging.

alyssa: Can everyone react with :thumbsup: once you can join the 9:30 dry run? Need quick confirmations.

devin: :thumbsup:

maria: :thumbsup:

samir: :thumbsup: will be there with SI leads.

jonathan: :thumbsup: eng oncall will be in the run channel.

alyssa: Great — final reminder: no press communication until 11:00 PT, internal standby channel is #launch-orbit, please keep noise to essential updates only. See you in dry run.
